title: God Gave Us Five Senses
objective: Students will learn about the five senses God gave them.
content: God made our bodies so special! He gave us five senses to explore His world. We can see, hear, smell, taste, and touch!
Our eyes see the beautiful world God made. Our ears hear birds singing. Our nose smells pretty flowers. Our tongue tastes yummy food. Our hands feel soft and rough things.
God gave us these five senses so we can enjoy His wonderful creation. Let's thank God for our amazing bodies!
activity: Go on a senses walk! What can you see? What can you hear? What can you smell? Touch something soft and something rough.
discussion: How many senses did God give us?
What do your eyes help you do?
What is something that smells good?
